text:
marie: FYI ramping into the change window — saw a canary get auto-rolled back because the approval never showed up in the console. deploy-bot said 'approval pending' for 22m. anyone else? :confused:

deploy-bot: Deploy 1812345678 requested by @marie. Mode: canary 5% -> 50% over 30m. Awaiting 2 approvers. Change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC. Approval TTL: 15m.

aaron: saw that on model-pricing-v2 rollout. The approver UI button didn't render for me for ~12m.

sasha: logs look noisy — our approvals endpoint is doing a big join with winsizes table. p95 jumped to ~11s at 22:03. probably UI timeouts.

ivan: confirmed. Postgres replica lag + approval-list query causing slow responses. Spike aligns with the start of the change window.

priya: short-term fix ideas: bump approval TTL for change-windowed canaries, and reduce polling frequency on the console to avoid hammering approvals endpoint.

marie: agree. short term I'll bump the TTL so change-window rollouts don't auto-fail. long term we need to remove heavy joins and add caching.

aaron: workaround for emergencies, you can run: `/deploy approve 1812345678 --force` but that's gated by role. we should add that to the runbook.

sasha: UX proposal: show an optimistic approve button that queues the request client-side and returns instant feedback, then retries in background if the API is slow. less scary for PMs.

priya: telemetry note: I'll add a dashboard panel for `approval_api.latency` and alert at p95 > 10s during change windows.

ivan: ops fix: add a tiny redis cache for approvals list keyed by rollout ID with 30s TTL to cut the load. avoids the heavy DB path when the console polls.

marie: decision items: 1) bump approval TTL from 15m -> 45m for change-windowed canaries (temp); 2) deploy a small-cache proxy for approvals; 3) implement optimistic approve UX. Who owns what?

priya: I'll own telemetry + alert and the dashboard panel.

marie: I'll push the TTL change to deploy-bot config now (manual change).

sasha: I'll pick up the UX optimistic approve PR and link the ticket to eng-releases. aiming to PR tonight.

aaron: I'll update the runbook with the `/deploy approve --force` steps and escalation path to eng-sre.

ivan: I'll prototype the redis proxy, can have a PoC tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Manual override applied: approval TTL for change-window canaries set to 45m by @marie. Note: bypass requires two approvers for prod.

marie: thanks all. if this happens again during the window, ping #incidents and include the deploy ID. :thumbsup:

sasha: quick config snippet for optimistic queueing I'm going to add in the console PR:
```json
{"optimisticApprove": true, "retryMs": 2000, "maxRetries": 10}
```

aaron: good call. let's not forget to version the approval schema so old consoles don't hit the heavy join.

priya: will add the alert and a dashboard link in the ticket.

marie: created ticket INFRA-4721 and assigned owners. adding notes from this thread. closing the loop for now. :white_check_mark:
